newsitem.title: CHINA: China's COSCO shipping warns of foreign competiton.
newsitem.headline: China's COSCO shipping warns of foreign competiton.

text.p: China Ocean Shipping (Group) Co (COSCO) said an influx of foreign competition was eating into the company's market share, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.

"Shipping companies from Europe, America and Japan are squeezing into the Chinese market, which was opened to them only a few years ago, posing a threat to state-owned COSCO," Xinhua quoted Lei Hai, deputy president of the group, as saying.
COSCO, a major container shipping line, told more than 400 of its employees at a meeting to discuss foreign competition that it must boost efforts to turn the tide, Xinhua said.
The news agency said COSCO planned to set up special companies to manage crews. It gave no further details of the company's strategy to counter the increased competition.
